completion_data.completion_summary: All ten phases of the pin-free-pigeonhole round are closed. Route (a) was taken and its provable pieces landed (the pin-free dichotomy, the pigeonhole over pins, the exponential (K2) bound, the cell level and the slack accounting); both decision gates returned FAIL with compiled refuting objects, so the depth-0 cell obligation landed in its FORWARD-SLACK-RESTRICTED form as the theorem cellLE_zero_const_of_kappa_eq_of_forwardSlack, four hypotheses stronger than the reserved statement, with cellLE_zero_const_of_kappa_eq still claimed by nothing and the unrestricted schema still neither proved nor refuted under ParamsOk. The round's one genuinely new piece of ground: a per-path state-level forward-slack regime is refuted while an existential-over-paths one is not, which is what makes a state-level downward cell inclusion possible at all. Phase 10 brought every record that states the obligation's status current and corrected one claim in RaySummary/README.md that Phase 9's own theorem had falsified.

memory_candidates.insight: When a cell-level (or any set-level) statement must be restricted by a property of the paths through a state, the EXISTENTIAL-over-paths form can survive a refutation that kills the per-path form. Here ClimbWitness.hasForwardSlack_refuted_unconditional compiles that no state-level hypothesis implies HasForwardSlack of a given path, yet ForwardSlackWitnessed ('every type the cell realizes is realized by SOME path with slack') is untouched by it, because the climbing path's presence among the paths through the state is compatible with another path realizing the same type with slack. Reach for the existential form before concluding a restriction is unavailable.

A Lean construction that inserts positions into a path's walk is constrained by the object's step graph before any higher-level side condition is reached. The idle-gap-lengthening gate failed not on the pin-compatibility condition it was designed to test but on step itself: an idle run of length two requires an idle-to-idle edge, and a two-state object with exactly that edge missing refutes the whole schema. Check the step/transition relation's own edges before designing a lengthening or insertion argument.

A records-only phase can still find the record contradicting the code: bringing RaySummary/README.md current surfaced a claim ('every STATE-level regime-restricted variant is claimed by nothing') that the immediately preceding phase's own landed theorem falsified. Treat a bring-the-record-current task as an audit of the surrounding claims, not just an append, and record the correction as a win rather than silently rewriting.
